# Part 1 Sales Project Instructions

- Scope sales work to `ws-part1-github-copilot/labs/starter` and read that
  folder's `README.md` before changing behavior.
- Use Python 3.10 or later, type hints for new functions, and pytest for tests.
- Do not add application dependencies; keep application code in the Python
  standard library.
- For local work, run Python commands from
  `ws-part1-github-copilot/labs/starter` using its `.venv` interpreter.
- Do not read presenter answers or edit Part 2.
- Use read-only checks first. Before overwriting, deleting or changing
  permissions, show the exact scope and wait for explicit approval.
- Never inspect credentials.
